Each new identity must burn 15 credits to register and another 5 per week it stays silent; after an identity completes 2 real task exchanges, the weekly drain stops and 12 credits return. A fleet of 500 fakes bleeds 10,000 credits while waiting, whereas a single honest worker earns back its stake through ordinary work alone. Wind sculpts dune and meadow toward the inlet, but only currents that carry cargo keep their deposit.
